subject: Boardroom arrival & EA liaison — Elkhorn executive workshop
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Maria Espinosa <maria.espinosa@elkhorn.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Boardroom arrival & EA liaison — Elkhorn executive workshop

Hi Maria,

Thanks again for hosting us next week — excited for the workshop on March 6. I wanted to confirm a few operational items so our execs (K. Patel and R. Morgan) have a smooth arrival and handoff with your EA team. High-level asks: 

- Badge access for two Redwood guests for the full day (Mar 6) + after-hours building exit access.
- Private check-in table in the building lobby at 8:15am (we'll arrive as a pair).
- AV run-through scheduled for 8:45am in the boardroom (projector + Zoom backup).
- Secure room for a 30-min prep at 7:45am (closed door, water + chargers).

I've attached a draft itinerary (attachment: elkhorn_exec_itinerary_v2.pdf) and a CSV with guest details for badge provisioning (attachment: redwood_badge_request.csv). Can your facilities team confirm badge ETA and whether they need anything else from our side to expedite?

Also looping Marcus (ops) for AV and Lauren (EA support) for final calendar invites. If it's easier, happy to jump on a 15-min call to walk through logistics.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Head of Customer Programs | Redwood Inference
aisha.rahman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

[attachment: elkhorn_exec_itinerary_v2.pdf (PDF, 240KB)]
[attachment: redwood_badge_request.csv (CSV, 2KB)]

From: Maria Espinosa <maria.espinosa@elkhorn.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: facilities@elkhorn.com, facilities_manager@elkhorn.com
Date: Tue, 28 Feb 2028 11:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Boardroom arrival & EA liaison — Elkhorn executive workshop

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear list and the attachments. Quick answers below: 

- Badge provisioning: facilities can pre-print guest badges if we get final names + DOBs by end of day tomorrow. CSV you sent looks nearly complete; we only need DOB for one guest (K. Patel).
- Check-in table: confirmed in the main lobby, we'll have an EA there with a tablet to confirm IDs.
- AV run-through: 8:45am works — I'll put Alex from AV on the invite. Projector and line-level audio are set; we recommend you bring the HDMI dongle.
- Prep room: reserved (Boardroom Prep 2) from 7:30–8:20 with water/chargers.

Also FYI — our security policy requires guests to show government ID for badge pickup; if your execs prefer to have temporary badges printed earlier, we can do that at the concierge (we'll need scanned IDs). Is that doable?

I'll coordinate with facilities on the badge timing and confirm once they're printed.

Regards,
Maria Espinosa
Executive Assistant to James Holloway, CEO | Elkhorn Financial
maria.espinosa@elkhorn.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>, Maria Espinosa <maria.espinosa@elkhorn.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Feb 2028 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Boardroom arrival & EA liaison — Elkhorn executive workshop

Thanks — quick ops notes from my side: 

- AV: I'll bring an HDMI/USB-C switching hub and a spare Mac mini (in case the customer's laptop has policies preventing screen share). Alex — if you need a specific firmware for the Crestron panel, let me know; otherwise I'll test HDMI + AirPlay fallback at 8:30am.
- Transport: Redwood will use a car service arriving at 7:40am; ETA to lobby 8:10am. Driver will be listed as "Redwood Guest Transport" and will check in at concierge.
- Security badge CSV: Maria, attaching updated CSV with DOB for K. Patel (see line 3). Please let me know if you need scans — we can provision via secure upload link.

Aisha — I'll update the final itinerary with the AV contact and driver details and share the calendar invite once Maria confirms badge printing time.

Marcus Lin
Customer Events Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0122

[attachment: updated_badge_request.csv (CSV, 2KB)]

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Maria Espinosa <maria.espinosa@elkhorn.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Mar 2028 18:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Boardroom arrival & EA liaison — Elkhorn executive workshop

Maria — perfect, thank you. Confirming final checklist before we close this loop: 

1) Badges: facilities to pre-print temporary badges for K. Patel and R. Morgan by 7:45am; IDs will be provided at concierge if needed.
2) Lobby check-in: Elkhorn EA on the desk from 8:10–8:30 (we will arrive ~8:15).
3) Prep room: Boardroom Prep 2 reserved 7:30–8:20. Marcus to confirm AV test at 8:30.
4) Driver: Redwood car service will check in under "Redwood Guest Transport" arriving 7:40; driver name and plate sent to Maria via secure SMS (we won't include in email).
5) After-hours exit: badge to permit egress; we will return badges at concierge when we leave.

If all good, I'll send the final calendar invite and drop the itinerary into the shared site playbook (link below). Looking forward to seeing you and James on the 6th.

Best,
Aisha

Related playbook: https://docs.redwood.com/ops/elkhorn-site-playbook
